items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Sidney Bechet's nephew and I used to go to school together.

ctx.x: I know. He played a lot of piano. I know he traveled with Sidney Bechet once about ten years ago exactly. I guess I heard him with Sidney in Chicago.
Sidney Bechet's nephew and I used to go to school together. We used to take up music together. He had a nephew who played banjo and guitar.
Which one is that? Was that one of Dr. Bechet's sons?
